subject.title: [Bug]: message send --media applies inconsistent local-media allowlist between WhatsApp and Telegram (same path, same invocation)

question: Should WhatsApp be required to enforce the same resolved local-media roots as Telegram for CLI `message send`, with no channel-specific permissive exception?
rationale: The observed behavior concerns a file-access boundary, and deciding whether any channel-specific exception is legitimate requires explicit owner intent before changing enforcement.

options.title: Enforce shared fail-closed roots
options.body: Trace the effective options and make both channel adapters reject paths outside the same resolved root set; add dual-channel regression coverage.

options.title: Document a deliberate exception
options.body: Retain WhatsApp-specific broader access only if an owner can name the supported contract, threat model, and operator-visible configuration or documentation.

recommendation.title: Enforce shared fail-closed roots
recommendation.body: Trace the effective options and make both channel adapters reject paths outside the same resolved root set; add dual-channel regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the closest evidenced routing candidate on the currently open local-media authorization work, although code ownership could not be established from available history.
